description: This Java source file defines the EchoServer class, which implements a mock server that handles HTTP and WebSocket requests, manages server lifecycle, and provides methods for testing and configuration within the mockserver project.

classes.name: EchoServer
classes.description: Main class implementing a mock server with lifecycle management, request handling, and configuration for testing purposes.

classes.name: EchoServer.NextResponse
classes.description: Inner class representing a queue of HTTP responses to be served by the server.

classes.name: EchoServer.LastRequest
classes.description: Inner class holding the last received HTTP request, used for testing and retrieval.

methods.name: EchoServer
methods.description: Constructs and starts the EchoServer, initializing server bootstrap and event loops.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the server and associated resources gracefully.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server, delegating to stop().

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: mockServerEventLog
methods.description: Provides access to the server's event log.

methods.name: withNextResponse
methods.description: Sets the next HTTP responses to be served, used mainly in testing.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears queued responses and resets last request, used mainly in testing.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the last received HTTP request, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: getRegisteredClients
methods.description: Returns the list of registered WebSocket clients.

methods.name: getWebsocketChannels
methods.description: Returns the list of WebSocket channels.

methods.name: getTextWebSocketFrames
methods.description: Returns the list of WebSocket text frames.
